QuestInfo.name: Helping the Town 2
QuestInfo.0: Ayan would like you to help the village out. How can you refuse? See what she needs.
QuestInfo.1: Ayan told you that the people at the Excavation Site near Perion are running out of supplies. Eliminate some Axe Stumps to get Firewood, and deliver it to Winston. #rAxe Stumps usually appear in #m102020200# or #m102020300#.#k
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated plenty of Axe Stumps, and collected plenty of Firewood. Winston should be pleased, right?

0.0: I have a bit of an emergency. There's an Excavation Site near Perion, and they're running out of supplies. I need you to get some essentials to them, before the whole thing falls apart, okay?

yes.0: Great. Eliminate Dark Axe Stumps, collect 20 pieces of Firewood, and deliver them to Dr. Winston. He'll handle it from there.
yes.1: Dr. Winston is at the North Rocky Mountain in #b#m102020400##k. You'll probably run into the Axe Stumps you need on the way to meet him.

no.0: ...No, that was the WRONG answer. Try again. Continued wrong answers MAY be punished.

1.0: I say, who might you be? I don't recognize you at all. Oh, are you here to deliver the Firewood?

yes.0: Smashing! Now the excavation can proceed as planned. Jolly good job, that. Might need your help again in the future, too!

item.0: The Excavation Site needs 20 pieces of Firewood. They need it NOW. Less talking, more chopping!
